source_title: Vortex Tool Company catalog (wood, plastic, composite tooling)
coverage_notes: Prose: down-cut tools must not plunge straight into wood and must ramp; up-cut spirals plunge; veining bits are end cutting and plunge. No ramp angle, no plunge fraction.
